summary: No operator website exists to verify against: the entry's website is the Franklin TDA tourism listing, whose 'Visit Their Website' link goes to the Facebook page ('Back to nature RV park, cabins and tent camping ... 10 minutes from Downtown Franklin', 175 High Haven Lane, (828) 369-2267, newest visible post 2024-10-26). Cleared the note-derived hookups/sites/season/booking/dump values, which rest only on RV Life/allstays; note left as written.
flags: Presence: Facebook-only. The website field is a tourism listing (experiencefranklinnc.com) that links to the Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/people/High-Country-Haven-Camping-and-Cabins/100057347504058/ (1.7K followers, 'Not yet rated (2 reviews)', newest visible post 2024-10-26). No operator domain resolves and RV Life lists no website. The only booking channels found are Vrbo/Expedia/Travelocity listings for its rental cabins (#7, #8, #10); no RV site is sold on any channel and no RV rate is posted, so the RV sites, hookups (8 sites, 30/50-amp, from RV Life/allstays) and 'reservations required' in the note cannot be confirmed from the operator. Price rests only on RV Life $$ (avg_rate $35). Phone (828) 369-2267 matches the entry.
